## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(car)
library(knitr)
library(corrplot)

df_full <- read.csv("Last_Year_All_Field_Bridges.csv")

df <- df_full[, c("X64...Operating.Rating..US.tons.", 
                  "X29...Average.Daily.Traffic", 
                  "X49...Structure.Length..ft..", 
                  "X48...Length.of.Maximum.Span..ft..", 
                  "X52...Deck.Width...Out.to.Out..ft..", 
                  "X27...Year.Built")]

kable(head(df, 6), caption = "Bảng thông số chi tiết")

colnames(df) <- c("OpRating", "ADT", "Length", "MaxSpan", "Width", "YearBuilt")
kable(head(df, 6), caption = "Bảng thông số chi tiết")

colSums(is.na(df))

df_clean <- na.omit(df)

colSums(is.na(df_clean))

summary(df_clean)



par(mfrow=c(1,2))


hist(df_clean$OpRating, 
     main = "Histogram of OpRating", 
     xlab = "OpRating")

boxplot(df_clean$OpRating, 
        main = "Boxplot of OpRating", 
        xlab = "OpRating")

hist(df_clean$ADT, 
     main = "Histogram of ADT", 
     xlab = "ADT")

boxplot(df_clean$ADT, 
        main = "Boxplot of ADT", 
        xlab = "ADT")

hist(df_clean$Length,
     main = "Histogram of Length",
     xlab = "Length")

boxplot(df_clean$Length,
        main = "Boxplot of Length",
        xlab = "Length")

hist(df_clean$MaxSpan,
     main = "Histogram of MaxSpan",
     xlab = "MaxSpan")

boxplot(df_clean$MaxSpan,
        main = "Boxplot of MaxSpan",
        xlab = "MaxSpan")

df_clean$Width <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(df_clean$Width)))

hist(df_clean$Width,
     main = "Histogram of width",
     xlab = "width")

boxplot(df_clean$Width,
        main = "Boxplot of width",
        xlab = "width")

hist(df_clean$YearBuilt,
     main = "Histogram of YearBuilt",
     xlab = "YearBuilt")

boxplot(df_clean$YearBuilt,
        main = "Boxplot of YearBuilt",
        xlab = "YearBuilt")

df_clean$Age_Group <- ifelse(df_clean$YearBuilt < 2000, "Truoc_2000", "Tu_2000")
df_clean$ADT_Group <- cut(df_clean$ADT, 
                          breaks = c(-Inf, 1000, 10000, Inf), 
                          labels = c("Thap (<1k)", "TrungBinh (1k-10k)", "Cao (>10k)"))

boxplot(OpRating ~ Age_Group, data = df_clean,
        col = c("lightblue", "orange"),
        main = "So sanh Tai trong Van hanh giua Cau Cu va Cau Moi",
        xlab = "Nhom Nam Xay Dung", ylab = "Operating Rating (Ton)")

boxplot(OpRating ~ ADT_Group, data = df_clean,
        col = c("lightgreen", "yellow", "coral"),
        main = "So sanh Tai trong Van hanh theo 3 Nhom Luu luong ADT",
        xlab = "Nhom Luu luong ADT", ylab = "Operating Rating (Ton)")




cor_matrix <- cor(df_clean[, c("OpRating", "ADT", "Length", "MaxSpan", "Width", "YearBuilt")])

corrplot(cor_matrix, 
         method = "pie",              
         type = "full", 
         col = colorRampPalette(c("#800020", "#FFFFFF", "#003366"))(200),
         addCoef.col = "black",       
         number.cex = 0.75,           
         number.digits = 2,           
         tl.col = "black",            
         tl.srt = 90,                 
         addgrid.col = "gray",        
         cl.pos = "r"                 
)

qqnorm(df_clean$OpRating, main = "Q-Q Plot of OpRating")
qqline(df_clean$OpRating, col = "red", lwd = 2)





```

::: {.callout-note icon="false" title="Result: One-Sample T-Test"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| comment: ""
#| warning: false
options(width = 90)
t.test(df_clean$OpRating, mu = 35, conf.level = 0.95)
```
:::

::: {.callout-note icon="false" title="Result: F-Test (Compare Two Variances)"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| comment: ""
#| warning: false
options(width = 90)
var.test(OpRating ~ Age_Group, data = df_clean)

```
:::

::: {.callout-note icon="false" title="Result: Welch Two-Sample T-Test"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| comment: ""
#| warning: false

test2 <- t.test(OpRating ~ Age_Group, data = df_clean, var.equal = FALSE)

cat("Welch Two Sample t-test\n\n")
cat("data: OpRating by Age_Group\n")
cat("t =", round(test2$statistic, 3), ", df =", round(test2$parameter, 2), ", p-value < 2.2e-16\n")
cat("alternative hypothesis: true difference in means is not equal to 0\n")
cat("95 percent confidence interval:\n")
cat(round(test2$conf.int[1], 5), round(test2$conf.int[2], 5), "\n\n")
cat("sample estimates:\n")
print(test2$estimate)
```
:::

#| echo: false
#| comment: ""
#| warning: false
options(width = 90)
bartlett.test(OpRating ~ ADT_Group, data = df_clean)

```
:::

summary(anova_model)
```

::: {.callout-note icon="false" title="Result: Multiple Linear Regression Summary (Full Model)"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| comment: ""
#| warning: false
library(car)
options(width = 90)

# 1. Chia tập dữ liệu Train (80%) - Test (20%)
set.seed(123)
idx <- sample(1:nrow(df_clean), 0.8 * nrow(df_clean))
train_data <- df_clean[idx, ]
test_data <- df_clean[-idx, ]

# 2. Khớp mô hình MLR đầy đủ trên tập Train
mlr_model <- lm(OpRating ~ ADT + Length + MaxSpan + Width + YearBuilt, data = train_data)
summary(mlr_model)
```
:::

::: {.callout-note icon="false" title="Result: Variance Inflation Factor (VIF Check)"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| comment: ""
#| warning: false
options(width = 90)
vif(mlr_model)
```
:::

::: {.callout-note icon="false" title="Result: Stepwise Regression Model (Optimized)"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| comment: ""
#| warning: false
options(width = 90)
step_model <- step(mlr_model, direction = "both")
summary(step_model)

```
:::

::: {.callout-note icon="false" title="Result: Test Set Evaluation (RMSE)"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| comment: ""
#| warning: false
options(width = 90)
preds <- predict(step_model, newdata = test_data)
rmse_value <- sqrt(mean((test_data$OpRating - preds)^2))
cat("Chỉ số RMSE trên tập Test:", rmse_value)
```
:::

::: {.callout-note icon="false" title="Result: Polynomial Regression Summary (Degree 2)"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| comment: ""
#| warning: false
options(width = 90)

# 1. Phân chia dữ liệu Train (80%) và Test (20%)
set.seed(123)
train_idx <- sample(1:nrow(df_clean), 0.8 * nrow(df_clean))
train_data <- df_clean[train_idx, ]
test_data <- df_clean[-train_idx, ]

# 2. Xây dựng mô hình Hồi quy Đa thức (Bậc 2 cho MaxSpan và Length)
poly_model <- lm(OpRating ~ poly(MaxSpan, 2) + poly(Length, 2) + ADT + Width + YearBuilt, data = train_data)

# 3. Xuất bảng tóm tắt kết quả hệ số và Adjusted R-squared
summary(poly_model)
```
:::

::: {.callout-note icon="false" title="Result: Polynomial Model Test Evaluation (RMSE)"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| comment: ""
#| warning: false
options(width = 90)

# 4. Dự báo trên tập Test và tính chỉ số RMSE của mô hình Đa thức
preds_poly <- predict(poly_model, newdata = test_data)
rmse_poly <- sqrt(mean((test_data$OpRating - preds_poly)^2))
cat("Chỉ số RMSE của mô hình Hồi quy đa thức trên tập Test:", rmse_poly, "\n")

```
:::

::: {.callout-note icon="false" title="Result: Baseline MLR Model Test Evaluation (RMSE)"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| comment: ""
#| warning: false
options(width = 90)

# 5. So sánh với mô hình MLR tuyến tính gốc trên tập Test
mlr_base <- lm(OpRating ~ MaxSpan + Length + ADT + Width + YearBuilt, data = train_data)
preds_mlr <- predict(mlr_base, newdata = test_data)
rmse_mlr <- sqrt(mean((test_data$OpRating - preds_mlr)^2))
cat("Chỉ số RMSE của mô hình MLR tuyến tính gốc trên tập Test:", rmse_mlr, "\n")

```
:::
